description: Reviewed the classified untranslated-text report for the Location Inventory WhatsApp stock-report release after synchronizing current main. The detector and policy digest are unchanged and unclassified findings remain at zero. The feature adds intentional user-facing configuration, manual-send, scheduling, history, retry, permission, and delivery-state copy in inventory/logistics; inventory-logistics moves from 1343 to 1473 actionable literals. Other module counts remain within their existing ceilings and the combined actionable total is 12455. This update pins only the observed reviewed feature delta; any additional untranslated-text growth continues to fail CI. Stock item names, stock group names, business names, codes, references, dates, and amounts remain outside translation behavior.
